about: Climbing areas for the Climbing factor and the Places layer (roadmap step 17, docs/plans/step-17-climbing.md §2). One entry per climbers' lot; each note is ours, read from the cited land manager's or coalition's page. Edit by hand, then run pnpm data:crags.

crags.name: Asheboro Boulders
crags.access: State-owned, NC Zoo-managed. Free daily reservation through the CCC required (it sends the gate code). Day use only
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Rough estimate; gate code after reservation

crags.name: Black Mountain (Crab Orchard)
crags.access: Cumberland Trail State Park: free online climbing registration; designated areas only; a narrow one-lane road up.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Cumberland Trail Conference trailhead N35°52.084' W84°53.253'

crags.name: Breaks Interstate Park
crags.access: A free climbing waiver every calendar year (online or at the park); read the park's climbing rules first.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated visitor center

crags.name: Carderock (MD)
crags.access: C&O Canal NHP, no fee found; no bolting; park in the last (north) lot; car break-ins reported.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated last (north) lot

crags.name: Castle Rock (Jasper)
crags.access: Lot on private land the SCC leases: text your car's make to the owner (number at the kiosk); don't park if full; no camping.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr Castle Rock parking 35°6'25"N 85°38'11"W

crags.name: Cedar Rock (Pisgah)
crags.access: Pisgah NF, no permit. Peregrine closures are posted near the climbers' trail. Butter Gap Trail reroute changed the approach
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated lot ~5.9 mi up Cathey's Creek Rd

crags.name: Coopers Rock State Forest
crags.access: WV state forest: no bolting; climb only in the permitted areas (not the overlook); sign in at the climbers' kiosk.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated climbers' lot near the overlook

crags.name: Crowders Mountain State Park
crags.access: Free permit at the visitor center or the access boxes. Rope climbing on the Linwood side only; bouldering at the Boulders area. Lots close when full
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Linwood Access lot

crags.name: Denny Cove
crags.access: South Cumberland State Park: free online climbing registration; no overnight parking; rough gravel road of about a mile off US-41.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated from 5917 US 41 entrance description

crags.name: Dragon's Tooth
crags.access: Jefferson NF trailhead: no fee, open all year; small lot fills on weekends, don't park on VA-311; a long hike and scramble to the spire.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: USFS Dragons Tooth Trail page trailhead lat/long

crags.name: Elizabeth Furnace
crags.access: George Washington NF day-use area, mid-April to October, sunrise to sunset; the Buzzard Rocks lot is small.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated day-use area on Fort Valley Rd

crags.name: Foster Falls
crags.access: South Cumberland State Park: free online climbing registration each visit; no rappelling in the climbing areas; off the trail by dark.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Atlanta Trails Foster Falls GPS, 498 Foster Falls Rd

crags.name: Grayson Highlands State Park
crags.access: Bouldering only: no ropes, no chipping. Virginia State Parks per-car parking fee; crash pads for rent at the park.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Massie Gap lot

crags.name: Great Falls Park (VA)
crags.access: NPS per-car entrance fee. Top-rope only, no drilling; climb from Overlook 3 to Sandy Landing, never in the canal cut; lots fill on summer weekends.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated lower lot

crags.name: Hidden Valley (Washington County)
crags.access: The CCC's climbers' lot needs no permit; the DWR lot and WMA land need a DWR access permit or licence; DWR lot closed to climbers Oct 1 to Jan 7.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated CCC lot on Hidden Valley Rd (SR 690)

crags.name: Horse Pens 40
crags.access: Private park: sign the waiver and pay the day-use fee at the Country Store; fees change, so check first.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr HP40 parking 33°55'19"N 86°18'27"W

crags.name: Jump Off Rock
crags.access: Town of Laurel Park, free, sunrise to sunset, under a CCC agreement. Small lot: leave if full, no big groups
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: CCC page parking GPS

crags.name: Kings Bluff (Clarksville)
crags.access: SCC-owned: get the gate code from the SCC and lock the gate behind you; park in the cul-de-sac, not in business spaces; no camping.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr parking 36°30'5"N 87°19'22"W, Max Ct cul-de-sac

crags.name: Laurel Knob
crags.access: CCC-owned. Only legal approach is the CCC trail from Panthertown's Salt Rock lot; Dillard Canyon side is private. No camping at the cliff
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Salt Rock Gap lot; Discover Jackson 35.14400,-83.03444

crags.name: Leda
crags.access: Private (Montlake Golf Course): check in, sign the waiver and pay at the golf course first; small lot; roadside pull-offs are tow zones.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr Leda parking GPS, across from Terrace Falls on Montlake Rd

crags.name: Linville Gorge: Shortoff Mountain
crags.access: USFS. Peregrine closures on parts of Shortoff each spring-summer. Small lot fills fast. Park only on the FS end of Wolf Pit Rd; private stretch is tow-away
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated end of Wolf Pit Rd

crags.name: Linville Gorge: Table Rock
crags.access: Wilderness, no permit. USFS: picnic area and lot closed after storm damage, trails open. Road gated about Jan 1-Apr 1. Watergroove area peregrine closure
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: TopoQuest Table Rock Picnic Area

crags.name: Little River Canyon: The Concave
crags.access: NPS preserve: park only in the marked pull-offs, all tyres off the pavement; no camping; no bolts added or removed.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated pull-off 1.7 mi along Canyon Rim Parkway

crags.name: Shenandoah: Little Stony Man
crags.access: Park entrance fee. Parts of the cliff closed all year, others about May to July for peregrines; no tree anchors.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Little Stony Man parking, Skyline Drive MP 39.1

crags.name: Looking Glass Rock
crags.access: Pisgah NF, no permit. North Face has seasonal peregrine closures (about mid-Jan to mid-Aug). FS 475B is gated seasonally, so check road status
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Lot on FS 475B (geocache N35 18.680 W82 47.878); hiking trailhead on FS 475 35.29095,-82.77660

crags.name: Moore's Wall (Hanging Rock SP)
crags.access: Free state-park climbing permit required; designated areas only. Small lot: no roadside parking, park hours, carpool
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Tory's Den lot

crags.name: New River Gorge: Bridge Buttress
crags.access: Pull-offs on one-way Fayette Station Rd (no vehicles over 12 ft); park only where marked.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated pullouts on Fayette Station Rd below the bridge

crags.name: New River Gorge: Endless Wall
crags.access: NPS, no fee. The small Fern Creek lot fills, and cars on Lansing-Edmond Rd may be towed (use the Nuttall lot); no overnight parking.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Fern Creek lot on Lansing-Edmond Rd

crags.name: New River Gorge: Kaymoor
crags.access: Park at the Kaymoor Top lot (the Arrowhead lot as overflow); no overnight parking.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Kaymoor Top lot off Gatewood Rd

crags.name: Obed: Clear Creek
crags.access: Climbers' lot on Doc Howard Rd owned by the East Tennessee Climbers Coalition; the park's rules apply on the bluffs.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated; climbers' lot at 124 Doc Howard Rd, Lancing

crags.name: Obed: Lilly Bluff
crags.access: Obed Wild and Scenic River (NPS), no fee: park at the Lilly Bridge lots, or the Overlook lots if full; Clear Creek can rise fast.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Lilly Bluff Overlook lot (The Outbound); NPS Lilly Bridge 36.10202,-84.71744

crags.name: Shenandoah: Old Rag
crags.access: Park entrance fee and an Old Rag day-use ticket (Recreation.gov) Mar 1 to Nov 30; no road-shoulder parking.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated main Old Rag lot on Nethers Rd

crags.name: Pilot Mountain State Park
crags.access: Free state-park climbing permit required. Designated walls only; the Big Pinnacle is off limits. Summit lot can close when full
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated summit lot

crags.name: Rocktown (Pigeon Mountain)
crags.access: Crockford-Pigeon Mountain WMA: a hunting or fishing licence or a Georgia Lands Pass, bought ahead; closed during posted hunts; no camping at the lot.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Atlanta Trails Rocktown trailhead GPS

crags.name: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area
crags.access: Alexander County park, free, open year-round. Climb on the quarry walls; check the county for current rules
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: HikingUpward quarry parking; VisitNC agrees

crags.name: Red River Gorge: the Gorge
crags.access: Daniel Boone NF: overnight parking (10 pm to 6 am) needs a recreation pass; no climbing within 300 ft of four named overlooks.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Martin's Fork trailhead near Nada Tunnel

crags.name: Red River Gorge: Muir Valley
crags.access: Private nonprofit preserve: signed waiver; a daily parking fee per car or a member pass; designated lot only; no dogs.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated main lot at the Fincastle Rd entrance

crags.name: Red River Gorge: PMRP
crags.access: The RRGCC's preserve: its signed waiver; free parking in the marked lots only, no overnight; keep oil-well access clear.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Rough estimate; RRGCC lots on Bald Rock Fork Rd

crags.name: Rumbling Bald
crags.access: Chimney Rock SP. Free climbing permit at the trailhead. Large lot off Boys Camp Rd; if full use other areas. Closed Christmas Day
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: CCC page parking GPS

crags.name: Sand Rock (Cherokee Rock Village)
crags.access: Cherokee County park: a per-car day fee at the gate; quiet hours 8 pm to 8 am; soft sandstone, so don't climb when it's wet.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr parking 34°10'50"N 85°49'2"W

crags.name: Sauratown Mountain
crags.access: CCC lease from YMCA Camp Hanes. Open only Dec 1-Mar 31, with the CCC's online waiver each year. Enter through the camp
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Baker Center lot, YMCA Camp Hanes

crags.name: Seneca Rocks
crags.access: Monongahela NF (Spruce Knob-Seneca Rocks NRA): open all year in daylight under a climbing plan; no permit or fee found.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated Discovery Center lot off US-33

crags.name: Stone Fort (Little Rock City)
crags.access: Private golf course: sign the waiver and buy a day pass at the clubhouse; no dogs, night bouldering or camping.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Rough estimate; climber parking at the Montlake Golf Course clubhouse, 9104 Brow Lake Rd

crags.name: Stone Mountain State Park
crags.access: NC State Parks: free climbing permit required (park office or the climbers' kiosk). Park hours apply
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: HikingUpward Lower Trailhead

crags.name: Summersville Lake
crags.access: Free WV state park; signed climbers' lot off US-19. Many crags need the lake low (the fall drawdown).
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated state-park climber lot off US-19

crags.name: Sunset Rock
crags.access: NPS military park: tiny West Brow lot, no street or yard parking; groups of 10 or more need a permit; no fixed protection.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr Sunset Rock parking 35°0'1"N 85°21'15"W, small West Brow Rd lot

crags.name: Table Rock State Park (SC)
crags.access: Park entry fee. Permit box on the climbers' trail behind the White Oaks Pavilion. Designated walls; Walker Buttress closed about Feb 1-Aug 15
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Estimated White Oaks Pavilion

crags.name: Tennessee Wall
crags.access: Prentice Cooper State Forest: no climbing during scheduled spring and fall hunts (check the dates each season); car break-ins at the lot are common.
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: climbingaway.fr T-Wall parking 35°4'3"N 85°24'12"W, lot on Mullens Cove Rd

crags.name: Whiteside Mountain
crags.access: Nantahala NF day-use fee lot. USFS and NCWRC close the Southwest Arete-Mainline section for peregrine nesting about Jan 15-Aug 15
crags.parkingFrom: estimate: Whiteside Mountain trailhead lot (Asheville Trails)
